6aaadf258cc64f2b2b7dbe3c: Ichigo must travel into the depths of Hell to save his younger sister Yuzu.
JoJo's Bizarre Adventure: Hol Horse and Mondatta, Part 1

Hol Horse arrives at Cairo in order to pursue Jotaro and the others. He has joined forces with another partner and is after the lives of Jotaro and crew once more. What's more, his new partner is none other than Mondatta.
JoJo's Bizarre Adventure: Hol Horse and Mondatta, Part 2

Following Mondatta's prediction, Hol Horse sticks his fingers into Polnareff's nose, but he doesn't know what to do from there. Making matters worse, Jotaro and the others show up in search of Polnareff, forcing Hol Horse into a tough spot.
JoJo's Bizarre Adventure: The Guardian of Hell, Pet Shop, Part 1

Jotaro and his friends continue to search for DIO's mansion in Cairo. Following Avdol's advice, they have a beggar look for the mansion and wait. Meanwhile, Iggy, wandering the city alone, is confronted by two large dogs.
JoJo's Bizarre Adventure: The Guardian of Hell, Pet Shop, Part 2

Iggy ends up in a battle to the death in the sewers against Pet Shop, the falcon that guards DIO's mansion. Despite being injured, Iggy runs to the river in an attempt to escape, but he may have underestimated Pet Shop's abilities.
JoJo's Bizarre Adventure: D'Arby the Player, Part 1

Though purchased dearly with Iggy's injury, Jotaro and his group finally have the location of DIO's palace. Waiting for them where they find the butler, Darby Younger, brother of the gambler they previously defeated.
JoJo's Bizarre Adventure: D'Arby the Player, Part 2

The battle for souls with D'Arby continues. Kakyoin challenges D'Arby to a racing game but ends up losing both the race and his soul. Before Joseph really has time to react, Jotaro picks the next game.
JoJo's Bizarre Adventure: The Miasma of the Void, Cool Ice, Part 1

The baseball game with D'Arby continues within DIO's mansion. For some reason, Jotaro starts telling D'Arby what pitches he'll be throwing. D'Arby finds Jotaro's actions strange, but still believes he has the upper hand because of his Stand's abilities.
JoJo's Bizarre Adventure: The Miasma of the Void, Cool Ice, Part 2

After a long, hard journey, the group is suddenly faced with saying goodbye to a friend. Polnareff can't control his emotions and starts brandishing his sword toward an unseen enemy with very little success.
JoJo's Bizarre Adventure: The Miasma of the Void, Cool Ice, Part 3

Polnareff is pushed to his limits by Cool Ice's merciless attacks. As he awaits death, the dying Iggy manages to save him at the last minute. Polnareff then stabs Cool Ice in the head. Despite showing resilience to the attacks so far.
JoJo's Bizarre Adventure: DIO's World, Part 1

Polnareff finally comes face-to-face with DIO. Despite Polnareff's hostility, DIO offers to forgive him and allow the Frenchman to join his side again. Polnareff refuses, but for some reason, he cannot get any closer to DIO.
JoJo's Bizarre Adventure: DIO's World, Part 2
As night falls, the battle expands to encompass the whole city of Cairo. Amidst the melee, Kakyoin says he has a way to figure out DIO's Stand ability.
JoJo's Bizarre Adventure: DIO's World, Part 3

Thanks to Kakyoin, Joseph is able to figure out that DIO's Stand, "The World," has the power to stop time, but is quickly defeated by DIO. Jotaro then attacks The World with Star Platinum but is no match for DIO's power.

With help from Polnareff as well as putting his own life on the line, Jotaro is finally able to land a blow on DIO. Finding the shriveled body of Joseph Joestar, Jotaro becomes enraged and wages his final, desperate battle with DIO!
JoJo's Bizarre Adventure: Jotaro Kujo! Meets Josuke Higashikata

In April 1999, Jotaro Kujo travels to a town in Japan called Morioh to find a young man named Josuke Higashikata, the secret love child of his grandfather, Joseph Joestar. Upon finding him, Jotaro is surprised to learn that Josuke also possesses a Stand.
JoJo's Bizarre Adventure: Josuke Higashikata! Meets Angelo

Josuke informs Jotaro about his encounter with Angelo’s Stand. Deducing that the serial killer’s Stand is capable of entering people’s bodies, Jotaro tells Josuke over the phone to stay on high alert until he arrives at his home.
JoJo's Bizarre Adventure: The Nijimura Brothers, Part 1

Josuke and Jotaro learn that a man with a bow and arrow was responsible for awakening Angelo’s Stand ability. Realizing the town is still in danger, they decide to find the bow and arrow before it can create any more victims.
Suiryu finds himself in the depths of despair. Despite all Saitama’s strength, there’s still something bugging the hero that he just can’t shake.
The Monster Association issues a challenge to the Hero Association, telling them they have only three days to rescue the hostage Waganma.
Garou is at last surrounded by multiple heroes and forced to fight, even though he’s covered in wounds and nearly at his limit.
Silverfang and Bomb catch up with Garou while the hero hunter is battling Genos, starting a whirlwind, climactic battle!
Yuki wakes up a vampire, and her memory of her childhood returns. She now remembers her father, her mother, and her brother.
Yuki now understands who she really is. Worried about Zero, she sneaks out of her room to find him. Zero cannot accept Yuki’s new self, and he points the Bloody Rose gun at her.
Absorbing Kaname’s blood finally revives Rido. The vampires all suspect this, and an unsettled mood enshrouds the Academy.
In order to protect the academy, the Headmaster confronts the head of the Hunter Society while Rido is still on the rampage.
Near contacts the Japanese task force and determines that Kira is among their members.
Star newscaster Kiyomi Takada becomes Kira's spokesperson to the world.
Aizawa figures out what's going on and tells Near, who already knows about the notes.
Light gives Kiyomi the order to finish off Near.

Susan is in a bind after spilling food on Sta'abi and apologizing about it.  Insulted, Sta'abi hunts Susan to feed her "fralnick" to Vornicarn.

Strange secrets begin to unfold when Derek returns to expose our friends at Area Fifty Something.  Monger is away for the weekend! This is great news for Team Monster and Team Alien until they're introduced to Rule-Bot.
Link and Sta'abi duel for driving privileges of a new supercar. Sqweep wants to drive too though, and takes off on a supersonic joyride.
With everyone down with alien flu, Coverton tries to steal base secrets, but fails to account for a huge gelatinous hallucinating B.O.B.  Vornicarn's bad behavior lands him in the Isolation Zone.
B.O.B. eats Dr. C's "probabilitator" and foresees Coverton with a crown, but soon Coverton discovers the painful truth about his future.

Sqweep has to go "number seven". Team Monster fears the destruction it will cause and sets out to contain it!  Link pursues Sta'abi using a pheromone spray of Sqweep's design that ends up having unforeseen consequences.

Susan and Bob play detective when Dr. Cutter arrives to update the base's technology.  Link and Bob find an old spaceship that they  take on a joyride, but things go bad when Coverton spots them and alarms the base of a hostile alien invasion.
After hacking into Monger's top secret files, the monsters learn that there was supposed to be another member of the team: The Man-Beast!

A stray kitten makes its way onto the base and accidently obtains Susan's ginormica powers! Sta'abi recruits Bob to teach her the "Art of Combat", after she witnesses him winning Link's new video game.
Monger gathers everyone for his favorite combat training exercise-a game of "no rules" dodge ball. Dr. Cockroach creates a special spray to give the President more authority.

The monsters start borrowing from Sqweep's allowance, but their spending spree soon comes to a halt when another alien planet arrives. After Dr. C messes with Sqweep's Earth Studies project, the little alien receives a Zrub--the lowest possible grade.
Dr. Cockroach's new teleportation experiment goes bad when he accidently teleports the Diner into space!
Susan has her ginormic hands full as she tries to escape the world wide web of an omniscient alien named... the Internet! Guest Star: Josh Gad
